title: Implement the forge CLI with structured check output and counterexamples

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: forge CLI v0.1 subset (design Appendix B): forge new (manifest+lockfile+skill pin), forge check [item] (run ladder, structured per-obligation JSON results). Parse Verus/Z3 output into the stable JSON schema (design 5.1): each obligation -> {address, status, level, solver_time_ms, counterexample?}. Counterexamples come from the solver, never just 'failed'. Reserve a suggested_move slot. forge goal/fill (incremental holes) are OUT of v0.1 scope.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
SHIPPED — forge check is the first live end-to-end command. forge/src/{cli,check,manifest}.rs: forge check <file.th> runs parse -> validate (thermite-spec) -> check_effects (thermite-lower) -> lower to Verus -> run the REAL verus binary PER ITEM -> structured JSON certificate (item/level/effects/slag/obligations + forward-declared contract_quality + counterexamples on failure). forge new scaffolds a project. ForgeError aggregates SyntaxError/SpecError/LowerError + verus/io variants; verus-absent is a reported environment error, never a silent pass.

LIVE CERT-ORACLE: forge check conformance/sum.th emits per-item certs (spec_sum L3, sum L3 [pure] slag=false) whose deterministic fields match conformance/sum.cert.json; binary_search L3. A broken contract -> non-L3 (L0) + a real verus counterexample with source span (counterexamples not adjectives, §5.1).

Loop: doc-author -> builder -> critic (found #41) -> fixer. #41 was the multi-item certificate SMEAR (one crate-level verus result copied onto every item, so a correct item was falsely non-L3 with a sibling counterexample) -> fixed by PER-ITEM certification (each item lowered+verus-checked in isolation; §5.3 locality, §6 per-fn level). Cert-is-real confirmed by the critic (genuine verus-derived level on fresh non-corpus programs; no hardcoded L3/identity coupling). Commits: 1004b7a (build) -> 9afba6a (critic #41) -> d0f92ca (per-item fix). Gauntlet: forge 25 tests, workspace 102 green, clippy -D warnings + fmt clean. Hand-rolled CLI (no clap). Out per design: degrade ladder #10, L2/Kani #9, mutation/vacuity battery #6/#12/#13, slag #6, proof cache #8. Separately: external reviewer flagged the quantifier-cage gap -> filed #40 (restrict SpecTherm closure bodies to a flat fragment). Not pushed.
